metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect burned area for the Alisal Fire in California - Date range: October 11-13, 2021 - Location: Alisal Fire was in Santa Barbara County, California (around 34.5°N, 120.2°W) - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for burn detection, or MODIS/VIIRS active fire products - Better approach: Use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or active fire detection 2. Masking strategy: - For burn area detection, we want to see the fire, so cloud masking is important - Use pre-fire and during-fire imagery to detect burned areas - Or use thermal anomaly/active fire products like MODIS or VIIRS 3. Logic: - Calculate burned area in acres - If burned area < 10,000 acres → A (Yes) - If burned area >= 10,000 acres → B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) - 10,000 acres = ~40.47 km² = ~40,470,000 m² I'll use MODIS or VIIRS active fire detection, and also try Sentinel-2 NBR approach as backup. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Alisal Fire location (Santa Barbara County, CA) alisal_center = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.2, 34.5]) search_area = alisal_center.buffer(20000) # 20km radius search area # Date range start_date = '2021-10-11' end_date = '2021-10-14' # Include one day after for detection print("Analyzing Alisal Fire burn area (Oct 11-13, 2021)...") # Method 1: VIIRS Active Fire Detection viirs = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(search_area) viirs_count = viirs.size().getInfo() print(f"VIIRS fire detections: {viirs_count}") if viirs_count == 0: # Try MODIS thermal anomalies modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(search_area) modis_count = modis.size().getInfo() print(f"MODIS images: {modis_count}") if modis_count == 0: print("No active fire data available.") print("C1") else: # Use MODIS FireMask band fire_img = modis.select('FireMask').mosaic() fire_area = fire_img.gte(7).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) stats = fire_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=search_area, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) area_m2 = stats.get('FireMask').getInfo() if area_m2 is None or area_m2 == 0: print("No fire pixels detected.") print("C2") else: area_acres = area_m2 / 4046.86 print(f"Burned area: {area_acres:.1f} acres ({area_m2/1e6:.2f} km²)") if area_acres < 10000: print("A") else: print("B") else: # Use VIIRS data - create binary fire mask and calculate area viirs_mosaic = viirs.mosaic() # VIIRS confidence band - select high confidence fires if 'confidence' in viirs_mosaic.bandNames().getInfo(): fire_mask = viirs_mosaic.select('confidence').gte(50) else: # Use brightness temperature as proxy fire_mask = viirs_mosaic.select(0).mask() fire_area = fire_mask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) stats = fire_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=search_area, scale=375, # VIIRS resolution maxPixels=1e9 ) area_m2 = stats.values().get(0).getInfo() if area_m2 is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") elif area_m2 == 0: print("No valid fire pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: area_acres = area_m2 / 4046.86 area_km2 = area_m2 / 1e6 print(f"Burned area: {area_acres:.1f} acres ({area_km2:.2f} km²)") print(f"Threshold: 10,000 acres") if area_acres < 10000: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Alisal Fire location (Santa Barbara County, CA)
alisal_center = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.2, 34.5])
search_area = alisal_center.buffer(20000)  # 20km radius search area

# Date range
start_date = '2021-10-11'
end_date = '2021-10-14'  # Include one day after for detection

print("Analyzing Alisal Fire burn area (Oct 11-13, 2021)...")

# Method 1: VIIRS Active Fire Detection
viirs = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(search_area)

viirs_count = viirs.size().getInfo()
print(f"VIIRS fire detections: {viirs_count}")

if viirs_count == 0:
    # Try MODIS thermal anomalies
    modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .filterBounds(search_area)
    
    modis_count = modis.size().getInfo()
    print(f"MODIS images: {modis_count}")
    
    if modis_count == 0:
        print("No active fire data available.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Use MODIS FireMask band
        fire_img = modis.select('FireMask').mosaic()
        fire_area = fire_img.gte(7).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        
        stats = fire_area.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=search_area,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        
        area_m2 = stats.get('FireMask').getInfo()
        
        if area_m2 is None or area_m2 == 0:
            print("No fire pixels detected.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            area_acres = area_m2 / 4046.86
            print(f"Burned area: {area_acres:.1f} acres ({area_m2/1e6:.2f} km²)")
            
            if area_acres < 10000:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    # Use VIIRS data - create binary fire mask and calculate area
    viirs_mosaic = viirs.mosaic()
    
    # VIIRS confidence band - select high confidence fires
    if 'confidence' in viirs_mosaic.bandNames().getInfo():
        fire_mask = viirs_mosaic.select('confidence').gte(50)
    else:
        # Use brightness temperature as proxy
        fire_mask = viirs_mosaic.select(0).mask()
    
    fire_area = fire_mask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
    
    stats = fire_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=search_area,
        scale=375,  # VIIRS resolution
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    area_m2 = stats.values().get(0).getInfo()
    
    if area_m2 is None:
        print("Calculation failed.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif area_m2 == 0:
        print("No valid fire pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        area_acres = area_m2 / 4046.86
        area_km2 = area_m2 / 1e6
        print(f"Burned area: {area_acres:.1f} acres ({area_km2:.2f} km²)")
        print(f"Threshold: 10,000 acres")
        
        if area_acres < 10000:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
